suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Resolution 2026 publishes this relationship only as postinfectious neurologic complication. Require documented Campylobacter infection preceding a separately diagnosed Guillain-Barré syndrome. Do not infer GBS from enteritis alone. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
evidenceGaps: Documentation that Campylobacter Jejuni Infection matches the source-specific phenotype
Independent diagnosis of Guillain-Barré Syndrome with compatible chronology
Assessment of competing medical, treatment-related, behavioral, and demographic contributors
